info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Banking Accounts Statements-v4-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Statements Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve financial statements for their banking accounts. This API is designed for banks and financial institutions to provide their customers with easy access to account-related statements. It serves typical users like account holders and financial analysts who need to monitor account activity, generate reports, or perform reconciliations. Through this API, developers can integrate statement retrieval functionality into applications, enhancing customer experience and financial transparency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the account statements associated with their accounts. It provides a comprehensive view of transactions and balances over a specified period.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving account statements. This includes necessary parameters to filter and specify the requested statement details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning account statements.
